task: Make an artwork archive easier to browse
context: A small public collection with five categories and square artworks
option_a: Place category selection in a dropdown with an Apply button
option_b: Show compact category tabs with immediate results and a count
rationale: Five short categories fit visibly; immediate feedback reduces a redundant step while leaving artwork dominant
principle: Expose frequent low-cost choices when the set is small
exceptions: Large taxonomies or expensive remote queries may justify grouped selection and Apply

context: Expressive type and saturated colour are explicit project requirements
option_a: Replace expressive type with neutral text and remove all colour
option_b: Retain the identity while clarifying ticket hierarchy and keyboard focus
rationale: Improves task completion while preserving the requested personality
principle: Refinement should resolve weaknesses within the chosen direction
exceptions: An explicitly commissioned rebrand can change the direction

task: Improve variety in a seeded poster generator
context: Every seed currently uses the same grid and a random hue
option_a: Add more random hue and opacity sliders
option_b: Introduce two authored subdivision grammars with constrained palette roles
rationale: Changes composition and rhythm while preserving reproducibility
principle: Review structural variety separately from parameter diversity
exceptions: A controlled colour-science experiment may intentionally fix composition
